cases.sentence: Вот слово, которое было к Иеремии от ___.
cases.translation: This is the word that came to Jeremiah from the Lord.

cases.sentence: Пойди в дом горшечника, и там я возвещу тебе мои ___.
cases.translation: Go to the potter's house; there I will announce my words to you.
cases.explain: Direct object of возвещу (will announce) requires accusative.

cases.sentence: Я пошел и увидел, как он работает за гончарным ___.
cases.translation: I went and saw him working at the potter's wheel.
cases.explain: Preposition за with 'at work' requires instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Сосуд развалился у него в ___, и горшечник сделал из него другой.
cases.translation: The pot disintegrated in his hands, and he made another one.
cases.explain: Preposition в (in) with location requires prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Что глина в руках горшечника, то и вы в моей ___, дом Израиля.
cases.translation: As clay in the potter's hand, so are you in my hand, O house of Israel.
cases.explain: Preposition в (in) with location requires prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Если я скажу о каком-нибудь ___, что я погублю его, но этот народ раскается.
cases.translation: If I announce concerning a nation that I will destroy it, but the nation repents.

cases.sentence: Расспросите среди народов, слышал ли кто-нибудь о подобном? Невероятные гнусности совершила девственница ___.
cases.translation: Ask among the nations; has anyone heard of such a thing? Virgin Israel has committed an abominable deed.
cases.explain: Subject of совершила (has done) requires nominative case.

cases.sentence: Они жгут благовония ничтожным идолам, они сбились на тропки, на ___ пути.
cases.translation: They burn incense to worthless idols and have strayed onto untrodden paths.
cases.explain: Accusative plural adjective modifying paths (which are accusative).

reading.ru: Вот слово, которое было к Иеремии от Господа. «Пойди в дом горшечника, и там я возвещу тебе мои слова».
reading.question: What was Jeremiah told to do?
options: Go to the potter's house where God would reveal His words
Go to the temple to pray
reading.correct: Go to the potter's house where God would reveal His words
reading.explain: Divine instruction to visit the potter.

reading.ru: Сосуд, который он делал из глины, развалился у него в руках, и горшечник сделал из него другой, какой ему захотелось.
reading.question: What did the potter do when his vessel broke?
options: He made it again into a different vessel as he pleased
reading.correct: He made it again into a different vessel as he pleased
reading.explain: The potter's power over clay demonstrates God's power over nations.

reading.ru: Что глина в руках горшечника, то и вы в моей руке, дом Израиля.
reading.question: What does this comparison mean?
options: Israel is as clay in God's hands
reading.correct: Israel is as clay in God's hands
reading.explain: The analogy shows God's sovereignty over Israel.

reading.ru: Если я скажу о каком-нибудь народе... что я погублю его, но этот народ раскается, то я передумаю.
reading.question: What does the Lord say about repentance?
options: If a nation repents, God will change His mind about judgment
reading.correct: If a nation repents, God will change His mind about judgment
reading.explain: God's justice includes mercy toward the repentant.

reading.ru: Они жгут благовония ничтожным идолам, они споткнулись на своих путях, на древних дорогах, и сбились на нехоженые пути.
reading.question: What spiritual problem do the people have?
options: They worship worthless idols and have strayed from right paths
reading.correct: They worship worthless idols and have strayed from right paths
reading.explain: Israel's idolatry has led them astray.

reading.ru: Расспросите среди народов, слышал ли кто-нибудь о подобном?
reading.question: What question does the Lord ask?
options: Has anyone heard of such wickedness among the nations?
Have you heard of God's blessings?
reading.correct: Has anyone heard of such wickedness among the nations?
